CREATE TABLE asset_assignments (
                job_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES workflow_jobs(job_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
                language TEXT NOT NULL,
                scene_id TEXT NOT NULL,
                asset_id TEXT NOT NULL,
                version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(version > 0),
                assignment_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
                uri TEXT NOT NULL,
                scene_plan_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
                scene_plan_version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(scene_plan_version > 0),
                effective_rights TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(effective_rights IN
                    ('CLEAR','RESTRICTED','UNVERIFIED','EXPIRED','BLOCKED')),
                target_use TEXT,
                status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('ACTIVE','REMOVED')),
                created_by TEXT NOT NULL,
                created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
                idempotency_key TEXT NOT NULL,
                PRIMARY KEY(job_id, language, scene_id, asset_id, version),
                UNIQUE(job_id, language, idempotency_key)
            )

CREATE TABLE asset_review_history (
                history_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                job_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES workflow_jobs(job_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
                asset_id TEXT NOT NULL,
                decision TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(decision IN
                    ('APPROVED','REJECTED','RESTRICTED','CHANGES_REQUESTED')),
                reviewed_asset_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
                reviewed_rights_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
                reviewer_id TEXT NOT NULL,
                note TEXT NOT NULL,
                occurred_at TEXT NOT NULL,
                idempotency_key TEXT NOT NULL,
                UNIQUE(job_id, asset_id, reviewer_id, idempotency_key)
            )

CREATE TABLE asset_reviews (
                job_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES workflow_jobs(job_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
                asset_id TEXT NOT NULL,
                decision TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(decision IN
                    ('APPROVED','REJECTED','RESTRICTED','CHANGES_REQUESTED')),
                reviewed_asset_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
                reviewed_rights_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
                reviewer_id TEXT NOT NULL,
                note TEXT NOT NULL,
                revision INTEGER NOT NULL,
                updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
                PRIMARY KEY(job_id, asset_id)
            )

CREATE TABLE asset_rights (
                job_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES workflow_jobs(job_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
                asset_id TEXT NOT NULL,
                rights_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
                uri TEXT NOT NULL,
                sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
                created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
                PRIMARY KEY(job_id, asset_id, rights_sha256)
            )

CREATE TABLE assets (
                job_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES workflow_jobs(job_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
                asset_id TEXT NOT NULL,
                kind TEXT NOT NULL,
                uri TEXT NOT NULL,
                sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
                review_status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(review_status IN
                    ('DRAFT','PENDING_REVIEW','APPROVED','REJECTED','RESTRICTED','EXPIRED')),
                effective_rights TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(effective_rights IN
                    ('CLEAR','RESTRICTED','UNVERIFIED','EXPIRED','BLOCKED')),
                rights_sha256 TEXT,
                created_by TEXT NOT NULL,
                created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
                updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
                idempotency_key TEXT NOT NULL,
                PRIMARY KEY(job_id, asset_id),
                UNIQUE(job_id, idempotency_key)
            )

CREATE TABLE claim_review_history (
                history_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                job_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES workflow_jobs(job_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
                claim_id TEXT NOT NULL,
                decision TEXT NOT NULL,
                reviewed_artifact_type TEXT NOT NULL,
                reviewed_artifact_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
                reviewer_id TEXT NOT NULL,
                note TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
                revision INTEGER NOT NULL,
                previous_decision TEXT,
                occurred_at TEXT NOT NULL,
                idempotency_key TEXT NOT NULL,
                UNIQUE(job_id, claim_id, reviewer_id, idempotency_key)
            )

CREATE TABLE claim_reviews (
                job_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES workflow_jobs(job_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
                claim_id TEXT NOT NULL,
                decision TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(decision IN
                    ('APPROVED_FOR_USE', 'REJECTED', 'NEEDS_MORE_EVIDENCE', 'CONFLICT_UNRESOLVED')),
                reviewed_artifact_type TEXT NOT NULL,
                reviewed_artifact_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
                reviewer_id TEXT NOT NULL,
                note TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
                revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
                created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
                updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
                PRIMARY KEY(job_id, claim_id)
            )

CREATE TABLE evidence_packages (
            job_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES workflow_jobs(job_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
            version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(version > 0),
            revision TEXT NOT NULL,
            uri TEXT NOT NULL,
            sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
            reviewer_id TEXT NOT NULL,
            note TEXT NOT NULL,
            created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
            idempotency_key TEXT NOT NULL,
            PRIMARY KEY(job_id, version),
            UNIQUE(job_id, revision),
            UNIQUE(job_id, idempotency_key)
        )

CREATE TABLE evidence_policy_decisions (
      decision_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
      job_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      run_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      policy_version TEXT NOT NULL,
      scoring_version TEXT,
      subject_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (subject_type IN ('CLAIM','SOURCE')),
      subject_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('AUTO_ACCEPTED','REJECTED','NEEDS_REVIEW','SOURCE_BLOCKED')),
      score REAL,
      claim_class TEXT,
      independent_groups INTEGER,
      components_json TEXT,
      reasons_json TEXT NOT NULL,
      evidence_json TEXT,
      acquisition_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
      analysis_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
      created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
      UNIQUE(job_id, run_id, subject_type, subject_id))

CREATE TABLE evidence_policy_runs (
  job_id TEXT NOT NULL, run_id TEXT NOT NULL, policy_version TEXT NOT NULL,
  result_uri TEXT NOT NULL, result_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL, counts_json TEXT NOT NULL,
  ready INTEGER NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(job_id, run_id))

CREATE TABLE integration_artifacts (
                job_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES workflow_jobs(job_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
                language TEXT NOT NULL,
                kind TEXT NOT NULL,
                version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(version > 0),
                status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN
                    ('QUEUED','RUNNING','SUCCEEDED','FAILED','INTERRUPTED','CANCELLED',
                     'AWAITING_REVIEW','APPROVED','REJECTED','SUPERSEDED')),
                uri TEXT,
                sha256 TEXT,
                input_binding TEXT NOT NULL,
                detail TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
                progress REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
                created_by TEXT NOT NULL,
                created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
                updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
                idempotency_key TEXT NOT NULL,
                PRIMARY KEY(job_id, language, kind, version),
                UNIQUE(job_id, language, kind, idempotency_key)
            )

CREATE TABLE integration_events (
                event_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                job_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES workflow_jobs(job_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
                language TEXT NOT NULL,
                kind TEXT NOT NULL,
                version INTEGER NOT NULL,
                event TEXT NOT NULL,
                detail TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
                actor_id TEXT NOT NULL,
                occurred_at TEXT NOT NULL
            )

CREATE TABLE job_workspaces (
  job_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  path TEXT NOT NULL,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  cleaned_at TEXT,
  cleanup_attempts INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  cleanup_error TEXT
)

CREATE TABLE provider_credentials (
                owner_id TEXT NOT NULL,
                provider TEXT NOT NULL,
                encrypted_value TEXT NOT NULL,
                last4 TEXT NOT NULL,
                updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
                PRIMARY KEY(owner_id, provider)
            )

CREATE TABLE publishing_caption_tracks (
                track_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                publish_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES publishing_jobs(publish_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
                language TEXT NOT NULL,
                name TEXT NOT NULL,
                source_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
                youtube_caption_id TEXT,
                state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('PENDING','UPLOADING','UPLOADED','FAILED')),
                error_code TEXT,
                updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
                UNIQUE(publish_id, language)
            )

CREATE TABLE publishing_job_events (
                event_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                publish_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES publishing_jobs(publish_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
                event TEXT NOT NULL,
                prev_state TEXT,
                new_state TEXT,
                detail TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
                actor TEXT NOT NULL,
                occurred_at TEXT NOT NULL
            )

CREATE TABLE publishing_jobs (
                publish_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                owner_id TEXT NOT NULL,
                job_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES workflow_jobs(job_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
                language TEXT NOT NULL,
                package_version INTEGER NOT NULL,
                package_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
                connection_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES youtube_connections(connection_id),
                target_channel_id TEXT NOT NULL,
                youtube_video_id TEXT,
                title TEXT NOT NULL,
                description TEXT NOT NULL,
                tags_json TEXT NOT NULL,
                category_id TEXT NOT NULL,
                default_language TEXT NOT NULL,
                visibility TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(visibility IN ('private','unlisted','public')),
                scheduled_utc TEXT,
                timezone TEXT NOT NULL,
                made_for_kids INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
                state TEXT NOT NULL,
                progress REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
                bytes_total INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
                bytes_uploaded INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
                session_ref_encrypted TEXT,
                attempts INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
                max_attempts INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 5,
                next_retry_at TEXT,
                error_code TEXT,
                error_message TEXT,
                approved_by TEXT,
                approved_at TEXT,
                approval_digest TEXT,
                approval_note TEXT,
                thumbnail_state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'NONE',
                verified_at TEXT,
                remote_status_json TEXT,
                quota_units_used INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
                idempotency_key TEXT NOT NULL,
                created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
                updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
                UNIQUE(owner_id, idempotency_key)
            )

CREATE TABLE publishing_profiles (
                profile_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                owner_id TEXT NOT NULL,
                connection_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES youtube_connections(connection_id),
                name TEXT NOT NULL,
                title_prefix TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
                description_template TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
                tags_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
                category_id TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '25',
                language TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'en',
                default_visibility TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'private'
                    CHECK(default_visibility IN ('private','unlisted','public')),
                timezone TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Asia/Calcutta',
                caption_languages_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
                made_for_kids INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
                created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
                updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
            )

CREATE TABLE scene_plan_review_history (
                history_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                job_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES workflow_jobs(job_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
                language TEXT NOT NULL,
                version INTEGER NOT NULL,
                action TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(action IN ('CHANGES_REQUESTED','APPROVED')),
                reviewer_id TEXT NOT NULL,
                note TEXT NOT NULL,
                occurred_at TEXT NOT NULL,
                idempotency_key TEXT NOT NULL,
                UNIQUE(job_id, language, version, reviewer_id, idempotency_key)
            )

CREATE TABLE scene_plans (
                job_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES workflow_jobs(job_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
                language TEXT NOT NULL,
                version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(version > 0),
                plan_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
                uri TEXT NOT NULL,
                sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
                script_revision_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
                script_version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(script_version > 0),
                package_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
                status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN
                    ('DRAFT','AWAITING_REVIEW','CHANGES_REQUESTED','APPROVED','SUPERSEDED')),
                created_by TEXT NOT NULL,
                created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
                idempotency_key TEXT NOT NULL,
                PRIMARY KEY(job_id, language, version),
                UNIQUE(job_id, language, plan_sha256),
                UNIQUE(job_id, language, idempotency_key)
            )

CREATE TABLE schema_info (
                singleton INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK (singleton = 1),
                version INTEGER NOT NULL
            )

CREATE TABLE script_review_history (
                history_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                job_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES workflow_jobs(job_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
                language TEXT NOT NULL,
                version INTEGER NOT NULL,
                action TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(action IN ('CHANGES_REQUESTED','APPROVED')),
                reviewer_id TEXT NOT NULL,
                note TEXT NOT NULL,
                occurred_at TEXT NOT NULL,
                idempotency_key TEXT NOT NULL,
                UNIQUE(job_id, language, version, reviewer_id, idempotency_key)
            )

CREATE TABLE script_revisions (
                job_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES workflow_jobs(job_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
                language TEXT NOT NULL,
                version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(version > 0),
                revision_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
                uri TEXT NOT NULL,
                sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
                package_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
                request_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
                status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN
                    ('VALIDATION_FAILED','AWAITING_REVIEW','CHANGES_REQUESTED','APPROVED','SUPERSEDED')),
                created_by TEXT NOT NULL,
                created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
                idempotency_key TEXT NOT NULL,
                PRIMARY KEY(job_id, language, version),
                UNIQUE(job_id, language, revision_sha256),
                UNIQUE(job_id, language, idempotency_key)
            )

CREATE TABLE source_review_history (
                history_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                job_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES workflow_jobs(job_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
                source_id TEXT NOT NULL,
                decision TEXT NOT NULL,
                reviewed_artifact_type TEXT NOT NULL,
                reviewed_artifact_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
                reviewer_id TEXT NOT NULL,
                note TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
                revision INTEGER NOT NULL,
                previous_decision TEXT,
                occurred_at TEXT NOT NULL,
                idempotency_key TEXT NOT NULL,
                UNIQUE(job_id, source_id, reviewer_id, idempotency_key)
            )

CREATE TABLE source_reviews (
                job_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES workflow_jobs(job_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
                source_id TEXT NOT NULL,
                decision TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(decision IN
                    ('APPROVED_FOR_USE', 'REJECTED', 'NEEDS_MORE_EVIDENCE', 'CONFLICT_UNRESOLVED')),
                reviewed_artifact_type TEXT NOT NULL,
                reviewed_artifact_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
                reviewer_id TEXT NOT NULL,
                note TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
                revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
                created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
                updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
                PRIMARY KEY(job_id, source_id)
            )

CREATE TABLE worker_claims (claim_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, job_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES workflow_jobs(job_id) ON DELETE CASCADE, stage_key TEXT NOT NULL, worker_id TEXT NOT NULL, attempt INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(attempt > 0), status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('ACTIVE', 'COMPLETED', 'FAILED', 'EXPIRED')), lease_expires_at TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, heartbeat_at TEXT NOT NULL, finished_at TEXT, failure_detail TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', FOREIGN KEY(job_id, stage_key) REFERENCES workflow_stages(job_id, stage_key) ON DELETE CASCADE)

CREATE TABLE workflow_artifacts (
                artifact_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                job_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES workflow_jobs(job_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
                stage_key TEXT NOT NULL,
                artifact_type TEXT NOT NULL,
                version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(version > 0),
                uri TEXT NOT NULL,
                sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
                schema_version TEXT NOT NULL,
                created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
                UNIQUE(job_id, artifact_type, version),
                FOREIGN KEY(job_id, stage_key)
                    REFERENCES workflow_stages(job_id, stage_key) ON DELETE CASCADE
            )

CREATE TABLE workflow_jobs (
                job_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                owner_id TEXT NOT NULL,
                idempotency_key TEXT NOT NULL,
                request_schema TEXT NOT NULL,
                request_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
                topic TEXT NOT NULL,
                language TEXT NOT NULL,
                status TEXT NOT NULL,
                created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
                updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
                queued_at TEXT,
                UNIQUE(owner_id, idempotency_key)
            )

CREATE TABLE workflow_stages (
                job_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES workflow_jobs(job_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
                stage_key TEXT NOT NULL,
                ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL,
                status TEXT NOT NULL,
                version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
                created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
                updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
                error TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
                attempt_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
                max_attempts INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 3,
                retry_after TEXT,
                PRIMARY KEY(job_id, stage_key)
            )

CREATE TABLE workflow_transitions (
                transition_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                job_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES workflow_jobs(job_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
                stage_key TEXT NOT NULL,
                from_status TEXT NOT NULL,
                to_status TEXT NOT NULL,
                stage_version INTEGER NOT NULL,
                occurred_at TEXT NOT NULL,
                error TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
                FOREIGN KEY(job_id, stage_key)
                    REFERENCES workflow_stages(job_id, stage_key) ON DELETE CASCADE
            )

CREATE TABLE youtube_connections (
                connection_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                owner_id TEXT NOT NULL,
                channel_id TEXT NOT NULL,
                channel_title TEXT NOT NULL,
                channel_handle TEXT,
                thumbnail_url TEXT,
                encrypted_refresh_token TEXT,
                granted_scopes TEXT NOT NULL,
                status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN
                    ('PENDING_CONFIRMATION','CONNECTED','REAUTH_REQUIRED','ERROR','DISCONNECTED')),
                confirmed_at TEXT,
                connected_at TEXT NOT NULL,
                last_checked_at TEXT,
                last_error_code TEXT,
                updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
            )

CREATE TABLE youtube_oauth_states (
                state TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                owner_id TEXT NOT NULL,
                redirect_uri TEXT NOT NULL,
                created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
                expires_at TEXT NOT NULL,
                used INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
            )

CREATE TRIGGER evidence_policy_decisions_no_delete
       BEFORE DELETE ON evidence_policy_decisions
       BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'evidence_policy_decisions is append-only'); END

CREATE TRIGGER evidence_policy_decisions_no_update
       BEFORE UPDATE ON evidence_policy_decisions
       BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'evidence_policy_decisions is append-only'); END
